claim: instance b=7, m=2, g=1 of a three-parameter family from a follow-up post to Rybin's announcement: fractional cost 125, every congestion-good unsplittable routing costs at least 126

source.author: Derived from an unverified social-media follow-up describing a three-parameter (b, m, g) family attributed to Juang, following Rybin's announcement; the arcs, costs, and constraints here are this repository's transcription of that post, not a verified primary source. Confirmed locally by exhaustive enumeration over all 8 congestion-good routings for b=7, m=2, g=1.
